|strategy=My favorite strategy is to keep this in my hand until my opponent puts [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo){{!}}R2-D2]] on [[Red 5]] with [[Luke Skywalker]].(But it still works great when R2 is on any Starfighter w/out a permanent astromech). First, I play this card on R2. The ship R2 was on will be stuck in space! That's when I move in my Star Destroyers for the kill. A great combo is to use this when [[Trooper Davin Felth]] is on Tattooine. Then it becomes a used interrupt.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20020803212220/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/dark/small/looksirdroids.html</ref>
